groups.name: Global University Systems · admin, automation and AI
bullets: Built a full-stack course pricing & discount management platform (React, TypeScript, Flask) handling hundreds of courses across regions and intakes; TanStack Table views cut admin lookup time 60%+; JWT-based RBAC for access.
Integrated OpenAI for course content generation, reducing manual effort by about 80%.

Anabin & ECCTIS automation: a Flask compliance API automating university recognition checks (H+, H-, H+/-); Playwright automation with session reuse cut latency about 40%; AI qualification matching with confidence scoring improved accuracy 35%+; audit-ready verification with screenshot pipelines and caching.

Chrome Extensions (BSBI + GISMA, Manifest V3) automating student application workflows, saving 3–5 hours per admin per day; PDF.js document extraction cut processing time 50%+; AI document classification across 17+ types at 95% accuracy; manual data entry down 70%, processing 7× faster, 99.9% uptime with local caching and retries.

AI document processing (CampusNet + BGV system): GPT-4 Vision and OCR validation APIs extracting structured data; orchestrator pipelines for multi-document classification; accuracy up 40%+ on payslips, EPFO records and certificates; fraud detection through cross-document validation with Anabin, cutting compliance effort 60%+.

Webster University application portal (NestJS, React, MongoDB): the full admissions lifecycle; JWT auth with HTTP-only cookies and CSRF protection; multi-step application with resume capability; encrypted email and SendGrid campaigns; Docker + Nginx production builds.

groups.name: EF Academy
bullets: Spearheaded a high-traffic multilingual marketing site on Next.js, Storyblok and AWS serving 1.25M+ monthly users in 23+ languages.
Led the TIBCO → AWS Glue migration, cutting annual costs from $24,000 to $840 (96.5%) with automated, scalable pipelines.

Built the Prospect Uploader (AWS Lambda, EventBridge, Salesforce CRM): 10,000+ leads per CSV with multilingual support, email alerts, and a validation UI to view and edit failed records; the client's reaction was a “Wow”.
Built the Prospect Viewer to list leads, surface validation failures and alert stakeholders.
Found and rolled out a translation tool in Storyblok with the team; the client wrote to say thanks.

groups.name: Incresco & Camped marketing sites
bullets: Led the Incresco revamp and built the Camped site with customizable UIs on Astro + Storyblok: 100% performance, accessibility and best-practice scores, improved SEO and sitemap generation.

groups.name: Planet SIM & Planet Business
bullets: Directed Planet SIM, an IoT app for apartment utilities with real-time updates over SignalR; managed Planet Business, real-time water service tracking with Firebase auth and REST APIs.
